Traditional platforms like Stripe, PayPal, and Gumroad offer user-friendly interfaces and integrated payment processing, but they do not cater to creators in restricted countries. Alternatives like NOWPayments provide a decentralized approach, allowing creators to accept over 300 cryptocurrencies with minimal fees. This architecture empowers creators with true ownership of their sales and customer data, ensuring they aren't reliant on a third-party platform that can impose restrictions or suspensions.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Stripe and PayPal have stringent geographic limitations, which exclude many aspiring digital entrepreneurs from accessing their services. PayPal, in particular, can suspend accounts at any time, freezing funds for up to 180 days without an appeal process. In contrast, COREMERCH's infrastructure, like the Edge Commerce Stack, is designed specifically for creators in these regions, enabling them to build a resilient online store without the risk of arbitrary account restrictions.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

While Stripe offers instant payment processing, the reality for those in unsupported countries is often delayed or unavailable access. Alternative methods, like NOWPayments, facilitate on-chain crypto transactions with a mere 0.5% fee, ensuring that creators can receive their funds swiftly. Unlike platforms that may charge hidden fees or impose lengthy holds, this model guarantees that creators keep more of their earnings without unexpected costs impacting their revenue.
True ownership means no more account suspensions or fund holds.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Ownership is a critical factor that differentiates these infrastructures. With traditional platforms, creators often face restrictive terms that limit their control over their products and customer relationships. By using solutions like COREMERCH, creators maintain full ownership of their digital assets and can automate product delivery through tools like Cloudflare Workers and Supabase, ensuring a seamless experience for their customers without being tethered to a single platform.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

Choosing the right architecture depends on your specific needs. If speed and efficiency are your priorities, the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) is ideal, deploying within 48 hours and allowing you to load multiple products with automated payment processing. For those wanting detailed documentation and guidance, the Sovereign Blueprint ($47) provides a comprehensive overview of how to set up an independent online store tailored to your location.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

Platform restrictions are not a customer service problem — they are an infrastructure problem. You cannot solve an infrastructure problem by calling support or finding the right contact at Stripe or PayPal. You solve it by building on infrastructure that was not designed around those restrictions in the first place. NOWPayments operates on blockchain rails — it has no correspondent banking relationships, no AML corridors to approve, and no geographic risk model that flags your country. It verifies transactions on-chain and fires a webhook. Your Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script receives the webhook and processes the order. The entire sequence is independent of any conventional financial institution.
Automate your product delivery with no third-party dependencies.

The search for platform alternatives ends when you stop looking for a better platform and start building infrastructure you own. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 deploys Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments under your accounts in 48 hours — no platform relationship involved at any layer after setup. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you the complete build documentation for both stacks if you prefer to deploy yourself. Either path results in a store that cannot be restricted by any payment platform's geographic coverage decision. See both options at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Stop using a friend's account in another country — this violates platform terms and puts both accounts at risk. Create a NOWPayments merchant account under your own email — no KYC required, takes under 15 minutes. Configure wallet addresses for USDT on Tron as your primary coin and Bitcoin as your secondary. Deploy your backend — Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script Web App — and confirm the endpoint URL is accessible. Set the endpoint URL as the webhook URL in your NOWPayments IPN settings with the secret key configured in both places. Build or deploy your storefront on Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages. Run a mainnet test transaction — send a small amount of real USDT to your configured address, confirm the webhook fires, the order logs, and the delivery email arrives. Promote your store only after the complete test passes.
